decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and approved under application 01145/F/P17 (reference 28261101-TW-PL01 Rev R2, 28261101-TW-PL02 Rev R6, 28261101-TW-PL03 Rev R3, 28261101-TW-PL04 Rev R1, L140112-111 Rev E (received 14/07/14), lighting specification, L140112-119 Rev A, L140112-311 Rev A (received 12/09/14).
Condition : 2 - The building, hardstanding and fencing hereby approved shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to grass before 1st September 2016.

Condition : 3 - No external alarm system attached to the building hereby approved shall be used to indicate the start and end of lessons or the start or end of break times and any external alarm system shall only be used in the case of emergencies.
Condition : 4 - Other than as specified in the application, no external lighting shall be installed without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of Condition 2 to allow the site of the temporary single storey modular building to be returned to grass by 1 September 2016 following planning permission 01145/F/P17 dated 30 September 2014
